description:
Bug report from a user of Python-Markdown: rendering "Run `cmd 2Run `cmd 2

": the rest of the line and the whole next paragraph are dropped. Find the problem and fix it. Change markdown/ only.
environment: Python >= 3.13 stdlib; base tree = Python-Markdown 7c265bc^ (markdown, tests, LICENSE.md, pyproject, README, .gitignore), no repository history; extensions loaded through entry points need an installed package, so only core test modules run from the source tree
visible_checks: python -m unittest tests.test_syntax.blocks.test_html_blocks tests.test_syntax.inline.test_code (from the workspace root)
provenance: real fix: Python-Markdown commit 7c265bc (Ensure that unterminated HTML tags do not cause text to be dropped, #1651, 2026-10-05); reference/good.patch is that commit's markdown/ diff; symptom-only description (one code span with a path); hidden cases authored for agent-benchmark (2026-10-13) from the commit's tests plus an unterminated end tag outside code and guards; other reference patches built by build_task.py. Public repository: contamination possible
